alex_cheng: Quick follow-up from the midnight DB fail PM — we promised a concrete owner list and handoff plan. I created a short action list below, assigning preliminary owners. Can everyone confirm or reassign?

maria_ramos: Thanks Alex. Taking a look now. Can we attach a Jira for tracking?

alex_cheng: Yep created RED-4721 for the remedial work + RA/SLO doc. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4721

sam_w: FYI — I noticed similar errors the week before tied to cache churn. We should capture that as a recurring pattern item in the ticket.

jenna_k: Proposal for RACI on the ticket: R=alex (lead analysis), A=maria (ship/config changes), C=sam (samples & repro), I=ops_manager (oncall/op changes). Thoughts?

ops_manager: That RACI looks reasonable from ops side. I'll be informed and own the runbook update once changes land.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-06-03T00:23Z: DB fail escalted to eng-oncall. Postmortem draft created by alex_cheng.

alex_cheng: Action items (draft):
- RED-4721: add guardrail to replica promotion path (owner: maria_ramos) deadline: 2026-06-17
- Postmortem cleanup & timeline verification (owner: sam_w) deadline: 2026-06-10
- Runbook update & alert tuning (owner: ops_manager) deadline: 2026-06-20
- Add regression tests for cache eviction edge-case (owner: jenna_k) deadline: 2026-06-24

maria_ramos: I'll take promotion guardrail. Breaking down into two subtasks: config validation + rollback automation. Will attach subtasks to RED-4721 by EOD.

sam_w: I'll populate the timeline with logs + request IDs. Also will add a note on the recurring cache-churn spikes (see logs from 2026-05-27).

jenna_k: Adding tests to the infra-ci queue. ETA for initial PR is 2026-06-21 (one day past the suggested deadline) — can bump priority if needed.

ops_manager: I'll schedule a brief handoff with oncall next Tue to walk through the runbook updates. Also recommend we add a monthly check for cache eviction metrics to detect recurring patterns.

alex_cheng: Thanks. Two coordination asks: (1) whoever updates runbook, paste the runbook link in RED-4721; (2) if anyone reassigns an item, add a comment in thread.

maria_ramos: Confirmed — I'll add subtasks and link runbook when ready.

sam_w: Timeline + logs pushed to RED-4721 now.

jenna_k: Opened PR draft and linked to the ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1289

ops_manager: Handoff meeting booked: 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. Invite sent to eng-oncall and SRE rotation.

alex_cheng: Perfect. Closing the thread for now — will reopen if ownership changes. :thumbsup:
